games.title: Animal Guess Game
games.description: Find the hidden animal! Pick an animal, flip the tiles and find it before your attempts run out. A free JoJo's Blocks game — no sign-up, no download.

games.title: Memory Match Game
games.description: Flip the cards and match the pairs! A free JoJo's Blocks memory game with three difficulties, best times and a timer that starts when you do. No sign-up, no download.

games.title: Tic-Tac-Toe vs JoJo
games.description: Play Tic-Tac-Toe against JoJo the AI — or a friend. Three difficulties, score tally, and a fair game: JoJo's wins count as JoJo's wins. Free, no sign-up, no download.

games.title: Click the Box Game
games.description: How fast are your reflexes? Click the moving box before time runs out and beat your best score. A free JoJo's Blocks game — no sign-up, no download.

games.title: Flappy Penguin
games.description: Flap JoJo's penguin through the pipes! Tap, click or press Space. A free JoJo's Blocks game — no sign-up, no download.

games.title: Block Drop
games.description: Stack the falling blocks, clear lines and chase your best score. A free JoJo's Blocks puzzle game — no sign-up, no download.
